title: Slope And Intercept
description: Interactive simulation for Slope And Intercept
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Slope
learningObjectives: Identify the roles of m and b in the slope-intercept form y = mx + b
Predict how moving the slope slider from -2 to 3 tilts the line and where it changes from falling to rising
Explain why changing the intercept slider shifts the line vertically without altering its steepness
Calculate the slope as rise over run from two points read off the plotted line
Distinguish a negative slope from a positive slope by the direction the line travels left to right
